whyMindsetDescFirst: Mindset was born in 2024 with the desire to make its contribution in an ecosystem where esport is taking more and more place; bring a vision that invites introspection and consider its place within this community.
whyMindsetDescSecond: Convinced that diversity is a strength and talent pool , Mindset is an inclusive esport event promoting versus fighting and each member of the fighting games community.
whyMindsetDescThird: We want to create an identity and an environment of trust where anyone who identifies with it can fully express themselves through a common passion.
whyMindsetDescFourth: Promote accessibility and inclusivity by creating a healthy environment governed by principles and values such as fair play, surpassing oneself, selfknowledge, self-esteem, resilience, adaptation...

rulesSFT6itle: Rules of the Street Fighter 6 tournament
ruleGlobal: The tournaments are open to people who are eighteen (18) years older on the date of their tournament registration. Any minor must be accompanied by a parent to participate in the event.
SF6Condition: Winner must keep the same character (can switch from Classic or Modern). Loser can switch their character.
T8RuleSet: We will apply the Tekken World Tour 2025 ruleset:
T8Finals: First to 3 for Winners Final, Losers Semis, Losers Final and Grand Final
T8Stage: Stage must be randomly selected for every game. Players must go back to stage select & pick random for every game
GGSTRuleSet: We will apply the Arc World Tour 2025 ruleset:
GGSTStage: Stage must be randomly selected for every game. Players must go back to stage select & pick random for every game
GGSTCharacters: Characters: No restrictions. However, additional DLC characters may not be used within the first two (2) weeks of release.
GBVSRRuleSet: We will apply the Arc World Tour 2025 ruleset:
GBVSRStage: Stage must be randomly selected for every game except if both players are agreed about it
GBVSRMusic: Music must be randomly selected for every game except if both players are agreed about it
GBVSRCondition: Winner must keep the same character. Loser can switch their character.
GBVSRCharacetrsColor: Lunalu's colors 17 et 18 and weapons skins EX are banned
